past_actions.summary: Execute standard daily operations: staffing rotations, equipment checks, revenue reconciliation, monthly maintenance log. Keep the garage running at peak efficiency. No visible change in posture.
past_actions.emotional_state: Composed. Slightly vigilant beneath the surface. Not anxious enough to act, not comfortable enough to be fully at ease. The kind of low-grade alertness you develop when you have dependents and a job that requires you to see problems before they become emergencies. Professionally, today is fine. Personally, I'm running a background process.

past_actions.summary: Launch active job search targeting facilities operations and property management roles. Update LinkedIn profile to de-emphasize 'parking' and lead with operations management, budget oversight, and compliance credentials. Apply to minimum 5 positions this tick: warehouse/logistics facility managers, commercial property operations, municipal facilities coordinator roles, hospital or university plant operations.
past_actions.emotional_state: Controlled urgency. Not panic — I have seen this coming long enough that the fear has had time to convert into focus. There is something almost clarifying about a deadline with a name on it. The ambiguity of 'eventually' was harder than '2 months.' Now I know what I am working against and I know what I have to offer. The stress is real but it is directional stress, the kind you can do something with.
